visible_description: 雨滴打出开头，几个等车的人把沉闷接成了一小段音乐。
synopsis: 雨天的站棚下，年轻人用指尖敲行李箱，跟着棚沿落水的声音打拍子。旁边的阿姨起初只是看着，后来拿鞋尖轻轻接上。撑着伞的孩子听懂了，用伞柄敲自己的掌心。车终于来了，三个人同时停住，又不约而同笑起来。上车前，年轻人给这支临时乐队行了一个无声的礼。
story_text:
雨把候车棚外的路面洗得发亮。年轻人坐在行李箱后，听棚沿的水一滴一滴落下，忍不住用指尖在箱顶敲了两下。

旁边的阿姨先看他的手，再听雨声，鞋尖便轻轻跟上。年轻人停一下，她也停一下；他敲三下，她把最后一下接住。两个人都假装没有在合奏。

孩子听了一会儿，把收拢的伞横着拿好，用弯伞柄轻敲自己的掌心。这回他们终于看向彼此，笑了起来。

车来了，门在路边慢慢打开。三个人同时停手，雨滴仍在演奏。年轻人拉起箱子，先朝另外两人欠了欠身，才走向车门。孩子也举起伞柄，郑重地回了一礼。
art_direction: Muted gouache with rhythmic colored-pencil rain marks on cream paper
character_design: A young adult with a dark undercut wears a plum sweatshirt, loose cream trousers and charcoal trainers, carrying a teal hard-shell suitcase. A middle-aged woman with a round face and tied silver-streaked hair wears a moss coat, brown trousers and low ochre shoes. A child about nine with a straight black bob wears a yellow raincoat and blue boots, holding a closed pale green umbrella. The bus is plain cream and muted teal with no lettering.

panels.caption: 雨点先起了一个头。
panels.scene: Inside a simple bus shelter, the young adult sits with a teal suitcase upright between both knees and taps two fingertips gently on its top. A clear sequence of drops falls from one corner of the shelter roof into a shallow puddle nearby. The middle-aged woman sits a short distance away with folded hands, looking toward the tapping fingers. The child stands beside her with a closed pale green umbrella, waiting quietly. panels.caption: 鞋尖悄悄接上了拍子。
panels.scene: Frame the lower half of the shelter while retaining the faces of the two adults in the upper part. The young adult continues tapping the suitcase with a relaxed grin. The middle-aged woman now lifts the toe of one ochre shoe just above the dry paving, beginning a gentle rhythmic tap. Her expression is pleasantly conspiratorial. The child turns from the rain toward the two moving hands and feet, recognizing their shared game. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.

panels.caption: 小伞柄也有自己的声音。
panels.scene: The child holds the closed pale green umbrella horizontally in one hand and taps its curved handle softly against the open opposite palm. Beside the child, the woman keeps her shoe close to the ground, and the young adult pauses a finger above the suitcase. Their three faces show concentration and delight without exaggerated performance. Outside the shelter, the plain cream-and-teal bus approaches slowly along the curb under soft rain. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.

panels.caption: 车来了，乐队一起谢幕。
panels.scene: The bus stands still at the curb with its door open. The young adult stands beside the teal suitcase and makes a small theatrical bow toward the woman and child, one hand over the chest. The other two smile back, their improvised instruments now completely still: the woman rests both feet flat, and the child holds the umbrella upright. The waiting area is calm, with the remaining roof drops continuing their tiny independent rhythm. Wordless illustration; no letters, signs, logos, captions, speech balloons or interface text.
